summary: Voyager Technologies filed an 8-K announcing a Fourth Amendment to its Credit Agreement. The amendment increases lender commitments by $50 million to $250 million and modifies certain covenants, with an uncommitted accordion feature allowing up to an additional $150 million for a total potential facility of $400 million. No board recommendation or advisors are named. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation. Watch for future financings or covenant compliance, but there is no risk-arb angle.
